description: Vertical operating system for auto service businesses — a multi-tenant SaaS platform covering customer management, vehicle tracking, work order lifecycle, inventory ledgering, expense tracking, financial reporting, bay view scheduling, mechanic portal, service reminders, and vehicle model catalogs. Built for the Mongolian auto service market with SmartCar.mn integration.

current: Ship Phase 1 features (customers, vehicles, work orders, inventory, expenses, finance, reports)
Polish existing 14 dashboard modules to production quality
Prepare for beta launch with real auto service businesses
next: Phase 2 features (services catalog, subscriptions, portal, organization management)
longTerm: Vertical OS expansion — become the operating system layer for auto services
Marketplace of integrations (SmartCar.mn, insurance, parts suppliers)
Self-serve onboarding with automated tenant provisioning

ui.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS custom properties for dark mode

stateManagement.clientUIState: Zustand (2 stores: ui-store, work-order-store) with devtools + immer + persist

database.rls: Row Level Security on all tables (enforced via migrations)

architecture.routing: App Router with [locale] dynamic segment for i18n

layers.components: src/components/ — feature folders (customers/, vehicles/, work-orders/, inventory/, expenses/, reports/, services/, bay-view-v2/, auth/, app-sidebar/)
layers.hooks: src/lib/queries/ — 24 React Query hooks with factory pattern
layers.services: src/lib/services/ — 40+ service files with test coverage
layers.types: src/lib/types/ — re-exported types from database.types.ts (7 type modules)
layers.stores: src/lib/stores/ — 2 Zustand stores with selector hooks
layers.api: src/app/api/ — API routes using api-handler.ts wrapper (ApiResponse<T> shape)

multiTenancy.strategy: organization_id on every table, resolved via middleware
multiTenancy.isolation: RLS policies enforce tenant boundaries at database level
multiTenancy.softDelete: deleted_at column — never hard-delete financial records

architecture.dataFlow: Page → React Query hook → API route → Service → Supabase

team.name: Temuulen Undrakhbayar
team.agentAssist: Pi (coding agent), Factory, CommandCode, Codex, OpenCode — multi-CLI setup with shared AGENTS.md
team.autonomyLevel: Autonomous (low breakpoint tolerance for babysitter mode)

development.testPairing: Test files in same commit as implementation

qualityGates.doctor: react-doctor for accessibility, bundle, architecture audits

documentation.location: docs/*.md files with sidebar config in docs/.vitepress/config.mjs

designSystem.rule: shadcn mandatory — raw HTML elements forbidden when shadcn covers the use case

conventions.apiRoutes: All routes use api-handler.ts wrapper (ApiResponse<T> shape)
conventions.spacing: Use gap-* with flex/flex-col, NOT space-y-* or space-x-*
conventions.sizeProps: Use size-* when width equals height
conventions.colors: Semantic tokens only (bg-background, text-foreground, etc.) — never raw colors
conventions.truncation: Use truncate shorthand, not overflow-hidden text-ellipsis
conventions.darkMode: Automatic via CSS variables — no manual dark: overrides
conventions.pageComponentLimit: Keep page components under ~400 lines, split at 500
conventions.i18n: Both mn.json and en.json must be updated together
conventions.databaseTypes: Regenerate TypeScript types after every migration

tools.rtk: rtk (output compression for verbose shell commands)
tools.portManagement: nextport (avoid port conflicts in parallel sessions)

supabase.purpose: PostgreSQL database, Auth, RLS, Edge Functions
supabase.usage: Primary data layer — all CRUD via Supabase client

smartcarMn.purpose: Vehicle data API — make/model/year search, parts lookup

externalIntegrations.name: SmartCar.mn
externalIntegrations.purpose: Make/model/year search, parts catalog, vehicle specifications

externalIntegrations.name: Supabase Auth
externalIntegrations.purpose: User registration, login, session management, PIN-based auth

externalIntegrations.name: DnD Kit
externalIntegrations.purpose: Drag and drop for bay view, work order items

painPoints.description: 71 migrations require manual type regeneration. database.types.ts is 130KB auto-generated file — importing directly causes silent build breaks on regeneration.
painPoints.mitigation: src/lib/types/ re-export layer + biome noRestrictedImports rule enforcing import from @/lib/types

painPoints.description: Every UI string must be added to both mn.json and en.json. Missing translations cause fallback keys in the UI.
painPoints.mitigation: Documentation rule in AGENTS.md, but no automated enforcement

painPoints.description: The report service is the largest file at 90KB — a maintenance and performance concern.

bottlenecks.description: Single developer across 14 modules, 71 migrations, 40+ services. Agent assistance (Pi, Factory, Codex) multiplies capacity but introduces AI-slop risk.
bottlenecks.impact: Feature velocity limited by review bandwidth
bottlenecks.mitigation: Multi-CLI agent setup, react-doctor, review-work skill, commit skill

bottlenecks.description: Every database migration requires: apply → regenerate types → update @/lib/types → verify build. Breaks developer flow.
bottlenecks.mitigation: MCP tools streamline the flow, but still manual

bottlenecks.description: report-service (90KB), bay-view-service (25KB), inventory-service (24KB) — approaching maintainability limits.
bottlenecks.impact: Code navigation, AI context window pressure, merge conflicts

agentProfile.primaryAgent: Pi (nextjs profile — supabase + shadcn + next-devtools + playwright + context7)
